xsheet.note: The submarine lies side on, bow to the left, tower and mast upright, the hull low in rough water.
The camera tilts down; the submarine rises in the frame. A wave washes along the after deck.
The hull is almost level now; the tower stays upright.
The boat drifts a little left, then back to the right as the camera follows.
End of the shot, just before the cut to the battleship.
